load_s2t_transformer_tokenizer: load an S2T Transformer tokenizer from a SentencePiece model file path and config
create_encoder: create a token encoder with language prefix tokens for multilingual speech translation
create_raw_encoder: create a raw SentencePiece token encoder without language prefix tokens
create_decoder: create a SentencePiece token decoder to decode token indices back to text
S2TTransformerTokenizerConfig: create a tokenizer config dataclass with task, target languages, and default language
